description: Explains a Portuguese home-buying or tax term (CPCV, escritura, VPT…) from the flatin.pt glossary. It gives the meaning, where it comes up when buying, and the article of law with a link. Use it to define a term; it calculates nothing: purchase taxes are `imt_calculate`, the yearly tax `imi_annual_cost`. Without `term` it lists all terms. A term without a translation comes in English; an unknown one is refused with close spellings, if any.

language.description: Language of the answer: the guide or the definition, the text summary and the page links. Field names stay English. uk is accepted as ua.

term.description: The term: Portuguese or English name, a name in any site language or an abbreviation (CPCV, IMT, VPT, caderneta predial, escritura). Omit to list all terms

name: glossary_lookup

anyOf.description: With term: the definition and the law.

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Explain a Portuguese home-buying term
